updates.title: Add a connection is one step

sections.heading: Widget
fixes: Hide and close no longer say that Ctrl+\ shows Hooxie again.

sections.heading: Dashboard
added: Add a connection is a service list, then Connect or a field to paste an API key.
fixes: Hiding Hooxie from the dashboard no longer says that Ctrl+\ shows it again.

updates.title: Corners stay small when the pill grows

sections.heading: Widget
fixes: Opening chat, setup, or menus no longer stretches the pill into giant rounded corners.

sections.heading: Dashboard
added: Connections has a clearer Add a connection row, a Paste an API key panel, and a list that keeps every service you connect.

updates.title: Setup moves on after the IDE

sections.heading: Widget
added: Choosing an IDE in setup opens the next step on its own.
fixes: The IDE list in setup is transparent like the rest of the pill.
Setup loads again so the IDE list and the rest of the steps can open.

sections.heading: Dashboard
fixes: Connections can open the IDE list and keep the IDE you pick.

sections.heading: Dashboard
fixes: The dashboard stays in front of the pill so light, dark, and sounds receive the click.
The sound list only includes sounds that can play, and Done uses Alert when the previous sound is missing.

sections.heading: Widget
added: A chat button between send and presets opens and closes the chat.
Sending a prompt opens the chat so the reply is visible.
The live line says when the Cursor agent is opening, when the prompt is sending, and when it is waiting for the first step.

updates.title: Closing the chat returns to the pill

sections.heading: Widget
fixes: Dragging the chat bar up closes the chat all the way back into the pill.

sections.heading: Dashboard
fixes: Clicking in the dashboard no longer flashes or rebuilds the page.

sections.heading: Chat
added: Under Agent working, the current step shows as soon as the agent starts.
fixes: Replies turn *italic*, **bold**, and `code` into formatted text instead of leaving the marks.

updates.title: Agent replies show in the chat again

sections.heading: Chat
fixes: An agent reply shows in the chat again instead of leaving only your message on screen.

updates.title: A running command stays under Agent working

sections.heading: Chat
added: Under Agent working, the command that is still running stays on its own line.

updates.title: The live thought stays one sentence

sections.heading: Widget
added: The project path can be a file or a folder.

sections.heading: Chat
fixes: The live line under Agent working shows the current thought instead of sticking the next sentence to the previous one.

sections.heading: Chat
added: Agent replies show bold and code instead of the ** and backtick marks.
Dragging the chat grip up closes the chat into the pill, and dragging it down opens that chat again.
fixes: Dragging the chat grip resizes the window smoothly.
A prompt is handed to the Cursor agent sooner.

updates.title: The chat shows what the agent is doing

sections.heading: Dashboard
added: Type, controls, and the content column are a step larger so the window is easier to read.
Connect opens a service key page when one exists; if it does not, the list returns to normal.

sections.heading: Chat
added: Under Agent working, a short live line shows what the agent is thinking or doing.

updates.title: The installer license is easier to read

sections.heading: Setup
added: The license in setup uses headings, spacing, and bold section numbers.

sections.heading: Dashboard
added: The desktop dashboard is a gray window with a white panel, icon rows, blue switches, and outlined controls.
Quit Hooxie sits under Toggle Hooxie and closes the app.
fixes: Undetectable mode hides both the pill and the dashboard from capture.
Opening the sidebar keeps the icons in place while the names appear.
The dashboard no longer says that Hooxie is on screen.

sections.heading: Dashboard
added: Fields, dropdowns, buttons, checkboxes, the slider, and tags use one paper style.

sections.heading: Dashboard
added: The dashboard uses the site's paper background, shorter settings, and a light/dark switch that slides.
Opening, Closing, and Done are dropdowns.
Connect opens that service's key page in the browser when one exists. When browser sign-in is not available, you paste an API key.

sections.heading: Widget
fixes: The pill background follows the opacity slider.

sections.heading: Dashboard
added: Connections is one dropdown. You choose a service, connect or disconnect it, and you can keep more than one.

sections.heading: Dashboard
added: Connections lists GitHub, Supabase, Vercel, Resend, and more than thirty other services, and checks whether each one answers.
Advanced holds an API key for an IDE or a service, a negative prompt, and memory presets that are sent with each prompt.
The project file list is no longer on Connections.
fixes: The dashboard opens in the Hooxie window. A browser tab no longer shows it.
Connections, the microphone, and the speaker open their lists in the window, and choosing an IDE switches to it.

sections.heading: Setup
added: The installer includes the newest Node.js 22 from the day it was built, and the Hooxie packages, inside the Hooxie folder. It does not change a Node.js already on the computer, and it downloads WebView2 only when that runtime is missing.

sections.heading: Dashboard
added: Settings groups appearance, audio, sounds, and the widget. Connections can unlink every IDE and show whether GitHub, Supabase, Vercel, Cloudflare, Resend, Stripe, or OpenAI is online.
Keybinds draw each shortcut as a key. Billing is one price and a code. Help links to the site, and Contact support is a card you can save.

sections.heading: Widget
fixes: The file chip stays compact. Opening a file puts its name at the bottom-left of the preview and the close button at the top-right of that preview.

sections.heading: Widget
fixes: An attached file shows its name in the bottom-left of the preview, and the close button sits in the top-right corner.

sections.heading: Widget
fixes: Advanced mode stays a rounded window, so the files panel is no longer clipped into the pill.
Hovering the attach button or an attached file greys it.

sections.heading: Widget
fixes: The prompt no longer draws a blue outline while you type.

updates.title: Faster launch and a slimmer preset list

sections.heading: Widget
fixes: Setup shows the IDE list inside the window, so choosing one no longer opens a blank dropdown.
A follow-up in the widget stays in the same Cursor agent chat, and that agent uses the same project rules as the IDE.
The chat stays put while the agent is working, and file changes open after the run finishes.
The widget pill matches the landing page demo: one dark bar, the prompt in the middle, and outline icons.
Setup stays a rounded window, so the IDE chooser is no longer clipped into the prompt pill.
The IDE dropdown opens again. Startup no longer stops before that list is wired up.
Toolbar buttons show a press, and their panels open with the window.
The undetectable dotted ring stays even instead of jumping as the pill changes size.
Dashboard controls grow only a little on hover, and the sidebar no longer clips that grow.
Clicks beside the rounded pill pass through to the window underneath.
Preset prompts have View and Edit, and each row is slimmer.
Hooxie opens before the Cursor connection and the IDE scan finish.
The dashboard browser starts when you open the dashboard, so launch does not wait on it.

sections.heading: Site
added: The intro progress bar is thicker.
The intro question sits a little lower.
The intro demo is a computer that plays on its own under Here's a quick Demo.
Learn more sits a little farther left in the hero control.
What is Hooxie says Hooxie is a desktop widget that stays on your screen and is invisible to screenshare.
What is Hooxie adds that it is very compact and invisible to screenshare.
The hooxie.com pages no longer show a scrollbar.
The intro demo always types a prompt, and the voice recording stays off that computer.
The intro opener fades in, with a pause before the second sentence.
The intro fits the screen on phones, short landscape screens, and desktops.
The intro opener's first line is larger, and the follow-up line is smaller.
The intro opener waits longer before the second sentence fades in.
The intro choices sit a little higher.
The last intro screen says Download it! and points Continue to hooxie.com.
Each intro step fades into the next.
The intro choices sit a little higher again.
Intro steps fade out before the next one fades in.
The intro demo uses the Hooxie pill and types the prompt on its own.
The intro pill sits above the page on the demo screen.
The intro slide titles sit at the same height as the opening sentence.
The intro choices are a little larger.
The site font starts loading with the page, and fonts, styles, and pictures stay cached for the next visit.

added: The installer downloads Node.js 22 and the WebView2 runtime when they are missing, then installs the Hooxie packages.

added: More options includes Advanced mode, which widens the widget and adds Files, Changes, Terminal, Details, and Look.
Arrow keys nudge the pill when the drag handle is focused.
fixes: The prompt has a visible name, and a sent message can be edited from the keyboard.

sections.heading: Dashboard
fixes: The dashboard window sits with other windows. Only the widget stays on top.
Buy stays on Opening checkout until the payment page is ready.

sections.heading: Site
added: Each feature card has a small drawing: dotted lines, keys, a saved prompt, and a usage bar.
Release notes list what was added and what was fixed in each version.
The voice demo asks Hooxie to create a blank page that says Hello World.
The blank page stays hidden until the voice prompt finishes, then pops in with Hello World.
The Hello World page is the same size as the page in the first demo.
An intro page walks through Hooxie, plays a short demo, then opens the landing page.
The demo computer uses a blue bloom wallpaper in the Windows 11 style.
The sentence under What is Hooxie fades on from left to right as you scroll. The heading stays plain.
What is Hooxie says Hooxie stays on your screen and off a screen share.
The What is Hooxie sentence is larger and centered.
What is Hooxie is smaller, the sentence under it is larger, and the fade starts later in the scroll.
Optional voice activation is larger.
The Undetectable drawing keeps the dotted outline and drops the solid bar.
Each feature card puts the title and description on the left and the drawing on the right.
Learn more reaches Features faster.
The hero no longer shows the Windows overlay sentence under the title.
The voice pill shows a recording wave instead of Listening, and the spoken line stays in the quote above it.
After Hello World appears, a second line asks to bold it, and the words turn bold as you scroll.

The voice pill sits in the horizontal center of the demo computer.
The What is Hooxie heading no longer has the blue dot.
index.html sits in the top left of the Hello World page.
Optional voice activation sits farther below What is Hooxie.
The Hello World scroll bold is a little thicker.
The intro has one page title, plus a canonical link and a share title.
The IDEs page is gone.
Hello World turns bold all at once when the second voice line finishes.
The intro opens lower, with the desktop widget sentence, and the voice choice says Voice activation.
The intro sentence types itself when the page opens.
fixes: The demo prompt on the site fills only while you scroll.
The homepage says Hooxie is a Windows overlay, and it no longer calls itself the number one widget.
The contact form says Sending while the message is checked, and repeat attempts are slowed.
The local site serves the bloom wallpaper, the intro, and the docs.

updates.title: Type fold, voice outline, and a license for this computer

sections.heading: Widget
added: The prompt stays on the bar, with upload on the left and send or voice on the right. Presets, more, usage, dashboard, and drag sit beside it.

View the screen, the project path, attachments, and the conversation open when you type, attach a file, already have a conversation, are listening, or the agent is working. Clearing the prompt folds them away.
When a line is about to run out of room, those controls move under the field. More typing wraps, and the field grows downward.
The widget opens a little lower on the screen. The scrollbar is only on the conversation.
More options can open the connected IDE on the current project.
More options includes Change IDE, which switches the IDE the widget uses.
Hooxie Setup 0.2.0 installs the app for Windows. The product site is hooxie.com.
While Cursor usage is loading, the ring eases around the circle, then fills to the percentage. That spin and fill take a little longer.
Ctrl+\ slides the pill off the nearest edge of the screen and fades it out. Showing it glides back. Pressing the shortcut again during the slide reverses it.
More options includes Recenter, which moves the pill back to the top center.
The app and installer icon is a sharper rounded pill.
fixes: The installer icon is a rounded squircle, so the setup file no longer shows a square tile.
Clear chat, Copy reply, and Send again have more padding, so the labels no longer sit on the rounded ends.

sections.heading: Dashboard
added: The search button and its search field are gone.
The website menu no longer opens a separate dashboard. The dashboard is the window inside Hooxie.
The window is white, with a grey sidebar and black text. Dark is still available.
Toggle Hooxie stays at the bottom of the sidebar.
Buttons and language choices are pills. A collapsed sidebar uses circles.
English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, and Chinese translate the navigation, help, and the one-time $5.99 purchase. Switching back to English restores the original words.
Opening a section eases in, and collapsing the sidebar glides.
Opening, closing, and done each have a sound list, shown as a waveform with the name and a play preview.
Dashboard motion fades in, and buttons grow slightly on hover and click.
Dashboard pages sit in the center of the window.
fixes: Opening the dashboard no longer stops on a missing catalog or revision.
The microphone and speaker lists stay open when you click them.
The dashboard stays on its own pages. Help, notes, contact, and downloads no longer open another site in that window.

sections.heading: Setup
added: Setup is two steps: choose an IDE, then the license. Back and Next move between them, and a progress bar shows how far along you are.
Each IDE has a plain Download link and a switch. On means the widget uses that IDE. Only one IDE can be on. An IDE that is not installed stays off.
Setup can be dragged, minimized, and closed. Help opens the onboarding section of the website.
Hooxie is $5.99 once for this computer. Sharing the app or the license file does not unlock another computer.
If this computer is already paid for, Hooxie finds that payment and continues.

sections.heading: Voice
added: Saying “Hooxie” starts one voice session.
The open sound plays when the typing outline appears. The close sound plays when that outline turns off, including when you click out of the prompt or stop voice.

Holding Escape for three quarters of a second clears the prompt and lets the widget go. While you hold it, the outline color closes around the border. When the hold finishes, the outline stays closed.
The blue-to-peach outline travels around the widget.
Placeholder questions type on one letter at a time.

sections.heading: Chat
added: Conversation text is smaller and more compact.
Queued messages are numbered cards. The first one sends next, and each card can be removed.

sections.heading: Site
added: The footer spreads Download, Help, IDEs, Releases, Contact, and Legal under Product.
Documentation covers the widget: the pill, prompts, presets, voice, files, the screen, usage, and shortcuts.
The home title and the Download and Learn more control sit in the center of the screen.
The home title stays locked while the demo computer scrolls up over it.
On a phone, the demo computer fills the screen while the prompt types, and the caret stays in the field.
fixes: Clicking the demo prompt lets you type in it, and scrolling no longer replaces what you wrote.

sections.heading: First build
added: The widget sits at the top of the screen and sends a prompt to a Cursor agent for the folder you choose.
One button is the microphone when the prompt is empty, send when there is text, and a square stop while the agent is working.
You can attach files, a folder, or a screenshot of the current screen.
Detectable can be turned off so a normal screen share or recording does not show Hooxie.
Keybinds hide or show the widget, ask about the screen, clear the chat, start a session, and move the pill.
